propositions: Rebar's structured-output seam must be investigated against Pydantic AI 1.107.2 using offline probe with real Agent/output/retry/fallback/limits seams and mocked-only transport to establish a behavioral-contract matrix mapping current Rebar behavior and observed Pydantic behavior with explicit disposition for each material delta.

Seven maintainer decisions on structured-output retry are required and must be made in order: one operation-wide request budget with raise-the-limit caveat; complete failed response on proven fit else whole omission; bounded output-size retry with concise guidance; terminal refusal/content-filter; aggregate successful-run usage; exact Rebar-owned cause-chain exception restoration; and trace-not-usage candidate observability.

The offline Pydantic AI 1.107.2 probe must execute real seams (Agent, PromptedOutput, NativeOutput, UsageLimits, FallbackModel, Hooks, ProcessHistory, FunctionModel, count_tokens, WrapperModel) with `pydantic_ai.models.ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS = False`, validate resolved version 1.107.2, report scenario pass/fail counts with deterministic SHA-256 result hash, and prove no live model calls occurred.

Current Rebar test suite (290+ tests across 13 focused modules) validates existing behavior cited as authority for every matrix row; all seven Phase-4 maintainer decisions were approved 2026-08-16 without `intentionally change` classification, leaving only implementation ticketization for the later Pydantic AI lane (story 155c).
